notes: Booklet is low-resolution isometric art; exact positions of several pieces (which studs they sit on) are best guesses, but the piece counts match the parts list exactly (28 pieces).

Steps: 1 black base; 2 two pink tiles in recess; 3 pink panel, yellow and light-grey 2x2 plates; 4 two white 1x3 bricks and bracket; 5 mudguard, wheel arch, two azure clip plates, two lavender plates, azure panel; 6 third lavender plate; 7 pink tile clipped to the two clip plates at the front, grille tile; 8 windscreen, four wheels with tyres.
The minifigure (Emma) shown in the booklet is not in the parts list, so it is not recorded.
Wheels are placed on the base's wheel pins; tyres have no ports and are listed as fitted onto wheels.
Windscreen is assumed to rest on the lavender plates b14 and b17; grille tile assumed on the rear wheel arch.
